title: Where the wolves were: the animals hiding in British and Irish place names
excerpt: Wolves, beavers, cranes and wild boar are long gone, but their names are not. I searched every named place and hill in Britain and Ireland for animals, threw out the false friends one by one, and mapped the 662 that are left.
seo_description: Animals in British and Irish place names: 33 wolf names, high on northern crags, plus cranes, beavers, eagles and boar, checked one by one.
header_alt: Title card on parchment reading 'Where the wolves were' in black and red lettering beside a map of Britain and Ireland dotted with coloured animal names, with the line 662 places in Britain and Ireland whose names keep an animal.
